messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
["Soon, we'll be adding enhanced online security-and we want you to know what to expect.", "we've temporarily limited what you can do with your account until the issue is resolved.", "You've sent a payment for 89.95 GPB to John Austin.", 'Thank you for providing us with an updated email address, richard@highwayman.com', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', 'Our Security department has blocked your account remote service.', 'We’ll send a confirmation when your items ship.', 'YOUR ACCOUNT HAS BEEN LIMITED !', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', 'Recent activity on your account seems to have occurred from a suspicious location or under circumstances that may be different from usual.', 'Your shipment is scheduled for delivery tomorrow.', 'You have an unconfirmed payment on your account.', 'APPLE PURCHASE SUCCESSFULLY PAYMENT CONFIRMATION SPOTIFY PREMIUM', 'Having carefully access your recent annual calculation of your fiscal activity, our record indicates that you are eligible to receive a tax refund of 370.00 GBP.', 'We have reasons to believe your account may have been accessed from previously unrecognized device and or location we are not sure if this was you or someone else, in order to keep you safe we temporarily freeze access to your account.', 'Either your information has been changed or incomplete, as a result your access to use our services has been limited.', 'Some Standard Bank customers have reported experiencing disconnect or write error issues with online banking.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "We provide updates on account activity, security restrictions, payments, deliveries, service changes, and actions needed to resolve issues or protect your account."}
